name: role_audit_trigger_v13
comment: The trigger snapshot (ADR-0042): a trigger records its neutral declaration — relation, timing, events in the fixed order, updateOf when declared, the body whitespace-collapsed with its tokens unexpanded — so the content is the same on every dialect; only the stamp differs (ADR-0043). Every implementation must export each document exactly from the trigger its native Role entity links.

sqlite.sql: insert into role_changes (role_id, role_name, changed_at) select n.id, n.role_name, {now} from {new: id, role_name} n;

sqlserver.sql: insert into role_changes (role_id, role_name, changed_at) select n.id, n.role_name, {now} from {new: id, role_name} n;

postgres.sql: insert into role_changes (role_id, role_name, changed_at) select n.id, n.role_name, {now} from {new: id, role_name} n;
